title: Lattice Pressure ROM
description: Read-Only Memory primitives governing the goal lattice's phase band — the pressure constants that hold an inferred folksonomy DAG over receipts in the 'superionic' regime (crystalline structure, fluid under pressure). Governing decision: _DECISIONS/ADR-023-observability-goal-lattice.md. Constitutional — these are L7 meta-governance constants, NEVER system-tunable at runtime. A system that sets its own decay rate can overrule revealed preference by choosing how fast it forgets — a NOTOMATION breach.
gated: L6 — not active until 100+ real receipts exist (same gate as ADR-020). This ROM defines the constants; the goal_edges overlay table is a future schema ADR.

references.drift_sentinel: runtime/specs/time-quality-attribution-rom.json#/drift_sentinel — phase monitor; this ROM does not redefine it
references.w_field_decay: runtime/specs/time-quality-attribution-rom.json — edge decay reuses the W-field decay curve; do not redefine
references.folksonomist: scripts/arcs_core.py:708 — folksonomist_cluster() is the bottom-up edge-growth operator

_constitutional_note: These constants are set by L7 governance. The lattice MUST NOT adjust them from its own dynamics. Self-tuning the decay rate, the contrarian cadence, or the calcification cap is a NOTOMATION violation and is forbidden.

counter_forces._comment: Three load-bearing external members (flying buttresses) that hold the lattice in the superionic band. Each carries thrust at a different level of the L0-L7 stack. They are NOT alternatives — they are a per-level defense. The drift-toward-calcification they counter is backed by preferential-attachment / loss-of-plasticity dynamics, NOT by any monotone-complexity theorem (see _adversarial_grounding).

edge_decay.guards: path survivability — an edge holds structure only if it keeps being re-earned
edge_decay.rule: Edge weight decays with age via the W-field decay curve in time-quality-attribution-rom.json. An edge not reinforced within its decay window loses weight and eventually drops below the lattice floor.
edge_decay.rationale: Keeps the proton layer fluid. Without decay the lattice freezes solid (calcified hierarchy). Decay is the only mechanism by which descriptive complexity can DECREASE — a closed system never sheds structure on its own.
edge_decay.constant_source: L7 governance — reuses W-field half-life; not independently tunable by the lattice

contrarian_injection.guards: cross-domain — forces the orthogonal edge so the lattice cannot simply thicken its strongest path
contrarian_injection.rule: On the governed cadence, the challenge tributary (ATG[1]) injects an orthogonal candidate edge against the current high-weight attractor. This is the 'sufficient pressure' that keeps the lattice in the high-energy superionic phase rather than relaxing to ordinary ice.
contrarian_injection.discriminator: Contrarian injection is the test that separates a SYSTEMATIC winner (a real attractor that survives orthogonal challenge and re-earns across varied opponents — may solidify) from a CONTINGENT winner (an edge that holds weight only because nothing pushed back — must be allowed to decay).
contrarian_injection.falsifiability_requirement: The challenge class MUST be pre-registered and scoring done on HELD-OUT members. Otherwise 'this edge found a pocket of reducibility' is unfalsifiable post-hoc (reducibility pockets always exist). Pre-registration + out-of-sample survival is what supplies the rigor; this test is NOT inherited from Wolfram's prose, which lacks it.
contrarian_injection.honesty_constraint: When a superordinate attractor precipitates, attempt reduction (describe the mechanism) and report the result. Permit 'attractor present; mechanism reduction attempted, none found' or 'not yet checked'. FORBID confabulating a clean rationale — a fabricated 'why' overrules revealed preference with a story (NOTOMATION).

calcification_guard.guards: cascade — preferential attachment ('rich get richer') is itself a cascade
calcification_guard.rule: A weight-concentration ceiling (Gini-style) over the lattice. When weight concentrates past the cap without a corresponding new attractor forming, flag a calcification cascade for the Drift Sentinel.
calcification_guard.rationale: Calcification is the danger mode of any positive-feedback reinforcement network. The cap is the explicit anti-'rich-get-richer' constant.

phase_band._comment: The phase the Drift Sentinel reads, measured by the descriptive complexity of the lattice's reachable goal-states (regular-language / minimal-automaton size of the reachable set is a defined scalar per Wolfram 1984; Nordahl 1989). Used as a POSITIONAL reading only. CRITICAL direction: calcification is the LOW-complexity pole, NOT high complexity. Rising regular-language complexity is ENRICHMENT, not freezing. This ROM does NOT assert the lattice drifts in any direction 'by theorem' — drift-toward-calcification is a preferential-attachment dynamic, not a CA-complexity theorem.

SOLID.reading: complexity collapses to a low bounded plateau — few effective states, one dominant hub
SOLID.meaning: CALCIFIED. The folksonomy has frozen into a de-facto rigid taxonomy. Counter-forces have failed or been removed.

SUPERIONIC.reading: complexity grows steadily and coherently — structure accumulating, attractors forming, but compressible
SUPERIONIC.meaning: TARGET BAND. Crystalline frame at L5-L6, fluid protons at L0-L1. Structure and flow fused.

GAS.reading: complexity grows unbounded with no plateau, or escapes regularity entirely
GAS.meaning: SPIN / CHURN. Edges thickening with no attractor forming — entropy masquerading as motion.

_adversarial_grounding._comment: This ROM was pressure-tested by a 5-agent deep-research pass (2026-06-05) against Wolfram's competition essay, NKS 6.7, and the CA regular-language-complexity literature. Four over-claims were corrected. Recorded here so the corrections are not re-litigated.
corrections: Irreducibility does NOT prove the tree cannot be declared (static DAG is reducible; irreducibility concerns prediction, not declaration). 'Inferred-not-declared' rests on NOTOMATION + folksonomy bias.
There is NO monotone-complexity theorem. Wolfram's CA result is 'usually non-decreasing' (empirical), with Class-1/2, surjective/reversible, and Hurd limit-set exceptions.
Rising regular-language complexity is enrichment, not calcification — the directional reading in phase_band reflects this correction.
The DAG is well-motivated by scaling/persistence/shared-structure, NOT computationally required (bounded-depth nesting is regular).
_adversarial_grounding.backing_for_calcification: preferential-attachment / rich-get-richer dynamics; loss-of-plasticity in continual learning — NOT the CA-complexity result.
_adversarial_grounding.source_caveat: Primary Wolfram pages 403-gated in the research environment; quotes are stable search-index reconstructions, not byte-verified.
